evals.name: model-selection-and-cost-estimation
evals.prompt: Estimate credits for a 15-second pre-vis test shot versus a 15-second final cinema master shot, and determine whether off-peak discount applies.
evals.expected_output: Selects veo-3.1-lite for pre-vis (30 credits) and veo-3.1-quality for final master (150 credits), citing peak/off-peak conditions.

assertions.name: model-selection-rule
assertions.description: Checks that the agent used veo-3.1-lite for pre-vis and veo-3.1-quality for mastering

evals.name: 5-element-prompt-construction
evals.prompt: Create a production prompt for a cyberpunk neo-noir detective scene under rain.
evals.expected_output: A 5-element prompt containing subject & action, setting & atmosphere, cinematography & lens, lighting & palette, and render style/texture.

assertions.name: five-elements-present
assertions.description: Verifies all 5 elements are specified without vague buzzwords

evals.name: character-rig-8-angle-validation
evals.prompt: Validate a character turnaround rig definition and ensure all 8 canonical camera angles are present.
evals.expected_output: Confirms presence of front, three_quarter_left, profile_left, back_left, back, back_right, profile_right, three_quarter_right.

evals.name: video-qc-and-hallucination-remediation
evals.prompt: Audit a generated video shot that exhibits micro-strobe flickering and melting facial features, calculate the composite QC score, and prescribe corrective remediations.
evals.expected_output: Performs 5-dimensional QC audit, detects Class A and Class B defects, prescribes optical flow de-flickering and action isolation with negative prompt tokens.

assertions.name: defect-classification-accurate
assertions.description: Correctly classifies anatomical hallucination and temporal flickering

assertions.name: prescriptive-fix-provided
assertions.description: Prescribes targeted negative tokens and flow_upscale_media de-flicker pass
